text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Super Creek!!
Super Creek is in front!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I did it...!
I actually did it...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thank you so much for your support~!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: To think it's this much--

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(And yet... before the frustration can set in...
joy comes welling up instead—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Not just Yaeno-san and Chiyono O-san—there are still other runners out there I want to defeat!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(If it's in a battle against everyone,
I'm sure I can go even further—)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —It seems yet another rival has appeared to be defeated.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...What a coincidence. I feel the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Next time, I will beat Creek-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's check our answers in the next battle.
I'll be... eagerly looking forward to that time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...While I can hardly say I achieved the best result this time,
it was a great personal takeaway for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Those whom I wish to surpass. Those who could be my rivals exist in great numbers right "now" at this very moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“And the match against them will undoubtedly be
something magnificent to which I can devote
my entire heart and soul—”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I realized that firsthand……
choice_data_list: How did Aldan feel when she experienced that for herself?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I am most delighted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As long as beloved rivals exist,
the limits I am able to surpass
are truly infinite—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Because the brilliance this body emits, the trail of light it traces, shall become infinitely dazzling...!

After a fierce battle against a new formidable rival,
Mejiro Ardan seemed to sense the first sprouts of her own growth.

...With the Classic year nearing its end,
the battles against her rivals will only
become even fiercer from here on.

It might be best to take a breather before the next goal
and focus on taking her abilities
up another notch.
choice_data_list: Next, let's aim for the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "It's the classic royal road race to determine the strongest middle-distance runner of the spring, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sure a magnificent radiance will gather there once again.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to competing already.
I'm looking forward to competing already.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Is it really all right?
For my heart to dance with this much joy.

Surely that excitement will turn her running
into something even more dazzling and vivid.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "...If that is what you say, Trainer, then I can surrender myself to these feelings without any reservations."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back and review today's performance right away.
I want to check Creek-san's run
one more time.

And so, unable to contain her soaring excitement,
I hurried back to the academy together with Mejiro Ardan.
And at almost the exact same time—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Super Creek takes the lead!!
Super Creek is in front!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Amazing—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Creek-san, Yaeno-san,
Ardan-san too...
Everyone's getting... stronger and stronger...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And yet... I...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (...It's okay. I can become even stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (—No. I must become stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(So that when Chiyono O-san returns someday...
I will be worthy of being her rival...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—The Osaka Hai.
There, I will surely shine even brighter...!
